description: This file defines a React functional component named PromptEditorView, which provides a comprehensive UI for editing, viewing, and managing prompts in a prompt-based AI application. It handles prompt creation, modification, versioning, tool integration, and interactions with backend services for saving prompts.

methods.name: getInitialPrompt
methods.description: Returns initial prompt object, parsing existing prompt data if available and handling errors.

methods.name: getInitialVersionId
methods.description: Constructs and returns the initial version ID based on prompt_spec data.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Adds a new blank message to the prompt messages array.

methods.name: updateMessage
methods.description: Updates the content or role of a message at a specified index.

methods.name: removeMessage
methods.description: Removes a message from the prompt messages array, ensuring at least one message remains.

methods.name: moveMessage
methods.description: Rearranges messages within the array by moving a message from one index to another.

methods.name: addTool
methods.description: Parses a JSON string to add or update a tool in the prompt's tools list, with error handling for invalid JSON.

methods.name: removeTool
methods.description: Removes a tool at a given index from the tools list.

methods.name: openToolModal
methods.description: Sets up state to open the tool editing modal, optionally for editing an existing tool.

methods.name: handleLoadVersion
methods.description: Loads a specific prompt version into the editor, handling errors and updating state.

methods.name: handleSaveClick
methods.description: Validates prompt name and triggers save operation, including modal display for name input.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Performs the save operation by calling backend APIs, handling both create and update flows, with success/error notifications.

methods.name: getVersionNumber
methods.description: Extracts the version number from a prompt ID.

methods.name: extractTemplateVariables
methods.description: Parses the prompt's content to identify template variable placeholders and generates example values.
